$description: specimen_ design tokens — SPC-BRAND-001 v1.2. Single source of truth for both code and Figma. Do not edit the @theme block in globals.css directly; edit this file and run `npm run tokens`.

primitive.$description: Raw values with no meaning attached. Referenced only by the semantic layer, never from JSX and never from a component. Every scope is empty so they appear in no Figma picker.

color.$description: The palette. Two neutral ramps, one green, three status hues.

600.$description: Dark control boundary. 3.29:1 on ink-950, clears the 3:1 floor for a form control edge.

900.$description: One step off the darkest ground.

50.$description: Light success surface. green-800 text sits on it at 5.10:1.

300.$description: Lifted green, for hover on dark.

500.$description: The signal green. Ink sits on it at 12.28:1 in both modes.

600.$description: Light hover on a sample fill. Ink on it at 8.93:1, where green-700 was used for both hover and pressed.

800.$description: Green that survives as text on paper. 5.24:1.

900.$description: Dark success surface. green-500 text sits on it at 9.62:1.

50.$description: Light danger surface. red-700 text sits on it at 5.54:1.

800.$description: Hover on a danger fill. Paper on it at 7.54:1.

900.$description: Dark danger surface. red-400 text sits on it at 4.60:1.

50.$description: Light warning surface. amber-700 text sits on it at 4.83:1.

900.$description: Dark warning surface. amber-500 text sits on it at 6.78:1.

50.$description: Light info surface. blue-700 text sits on it at 5.62:1.

900.$description: Dark info surface. blue-400 text sits on it at 6.61:1.

scrim.$description: Ink-950 at two opacities, for the layer between an open overlay and the page. The only translucent values in the system.

40.$description: Ink-950 at 40%. Dims a light page without turning it grey.

72.$description: Ink-950 at 72%. A dark page needs more to read as recessed.

size.$description: One ramp of lengths. Spacing, border weight and radius all draw from it, which is how border/strong and border/focus end up provably the same 2px.

font-size.$description: Every type size in the codebase, as a raw value.

font-family.$description: The two families, with their fallback stacks.

tracking.$description: Letter spacing in em. Figma stores these as a percentage, because a FLOAT bound to letterSpacing resolves as pixels.

line-height.$description: Unitless ratios, named by their percentage.

color.$description: Semantic colour, two modes. Every value is an alias to a primitive, so a hue changes in one place. Contrast figures in the descriptions are measured against the canvas of that mode. Status roles come in pairs: a text/stroke colour and a -subtle surface it sits on.

surface.$description: A raised surface: panels, menus, table headers. One step away from the canvas in both modes.

ink.$description: Primary text. The name is the role, not the colour: it resolves to paper on a dark canvas.

muted.$description: Secondary text. Clears AA in both modes.

faint.$description: Tertiary text and placeholders. Clears AA in both modes, which the old dark value did not.

line.$description: The default rule. Decorative, so it sits below the 3:1 floor on purpose.

line-interactive.$description: The boundary of a form control. Clears 3:1 in both modes, which WCAG 1.4.11 requires and a decorative rule does not.

sample.$description: Signal green as text, links and borders. Darkens in light mode so it stays readable on paper.

sample-fill.$description: Signal green as a surface: buttons, the specimen dot. The same green in both modes, always with on-sample text over it.

sample-hover.$description: Hover on a sample fill. Lifted in dark, deepened in light. Ink stays readable on both.

sample-pressed.$description: Pressed state on a sample fill. Was green-800 in light, where ink on it fell to 3.38:1.

on-sample.$description: Text and icons sitting on sample-fill. Ink in both modes: 12.28:1 either way.

danger.$description: Error text and borders. Clears AA in both modes, which the old dark value did not.

success.$description: Success text and borders. Success is the brand green doing its job as a status: the specimen is alive.

info.$description: Informational text and borders. The only hue that is not brand or status-red/amber.

danger-subtle.$description: Low-emphasis danger surface for inline alerts, invalid rows and toasts. Always with danger text over it.

warn-subtle.$description: Low-emphasis warning surface. Always with warn text over it.

success-subtle.$description: Low-emphasis success surface. Always with success text over it.

info-subtle.$description: Low-emphasis info surface. Always with info text over it.

danger-fill.$description: Destructive action as a surface: the confirm button in a delete dialog. Same red in both modes, always with on-danger text.

danger-hover.$description: Hover and pressed on a danger fill.

on-danger.$description: Text and icons sitting on danger-fill. Paper in both modes: 5.92:1.

disabled.$description: Text and border of a disabled control. Around 3.3:1 in both modes: legible, clearly inert, and exempt from the AA text floor. Replaces opacity.

scrim.$description: The layer behind an open Dialog. Separates by dimming, not by shadow: the system stays flat (brand §06) and the overlay itself carries surface and line-strong.

spacing.$description: 4px base, fifteen named steps. Auto-layout gaps and padding in Figma bind to the same variables the Tailwind utilities read, so a step is one value in two places.

none.$description: Collapse a gap or padding without leaving the scale. Dense table rows and flush-joined controls.

2xs.$description: Icon to label inside a control, and the optical nudges that used to be written as mt-[2px].

xs.$description: Tightest real gap. Chip internals, inline meta.

sm.$description: Dense table cell padding, gap between adjacent controls.

lg.$description: Default padding inside a control or cell.

3xl.$description: Gap between groups within a panel.

9xl.$description: Marketing sections and the space above a page title on a landing view.

border.$description: Stroke weights. The system separates surfaces with a line rather than with elevation, so weight is doing work that shadow does elsewhere.

none.$description: Remove an edge in a variant without dropping off the scale.

hairline.$description: Every rule, panel edge, table row and input outline. The default.

strong.$description: Emphasis. A selected table row, an active tab, the open item in a list.

focus.$description: The focus ring, drawn as an outline with a 2px offset. Same weight as strong, kept separate so changing the ring never moves the selection state.

accent.$description: A leading edge that carries meaning: the left bar on an alert or callout, keyed to a status colour.

radius.$description: Corners come from the mark: its slide has a 4px corner, so controls take 4px and the panels that hold them take 8px. The dot family is fully round. SPC-BRAND-001 v1.2, section 07.

none.$description: Square. Rules, table cells, tabs, anything that is structure rather than an object.

sm.$description: Controls: buttons, fields, selects, checkboxes, tags, menu items, tooltips. The mark's own corner.

md.$description: Panels that float or frame: dialogs, popovers, menus, toasts, the command menu, preview frames.

full.$description: The dot family: the specimen dot, radios, the switch track and its thumb.

text.$description: Type scale derived from sizes already in the codebase. Each step becomes a Figma text style and a Tailwind text-* utility.

label.$description: Field labels, meta rows. Most common size in the codebase.

font.$description: The two families. Mono is the default voice; sans appears only where a paragraph has to be read at length.

mono.$description: IBM Plex Mono. The default voice of the system.

text.$description: Archivo Variable. Used sparingly for display.

tracking.$description: Letter spacing, applied through the Text/* styles as a percentage rather than bound to a variable.

label.$description: Uppercase labels. Applied through the Text/* styles as a percentage, never bound to letterSpacing directly: a FLOAT variable bound to letterSpacing resolves as pixels, not em.

tag.$description: The tag component. Applied through the Text/* styles as a percentage, never bound to letterSpacing directly: a FLOAT variable bound to letterSpacing resolves as pixels, not em.

display.$description: Tightened display type. Applied through the Text/* styles as a percentage, never bound to letterSpacing directly: a FLOAT variable bound to letterSpacing resolves as pixels, not em.

wordmark.$description: The wordmark only. Applied through the Text/* styles as a percentage, never bound to letterSpacing directly: a FLOAT variable bound to letterSpacing resolves as pixels, not em.

leading.$description: Line height as a unitless ratio. Taken from the values already in use in the codebase.

duration.$description: How long a transition or loop runs.

blink.$description: The cursor blink in .spc-cursor. step-end, infinite.

ease.$description: The single easing curve in the system.

breakpoint.$description: Tailwind v4 defaults, recorded so Figma frame widths and CSS agree. Min-width, mobile first.

sm.$description: Large phone and up. 14 uses in the codebase.

lg.$description: Tablet landscape and small laptop. 4 uses.

measure.$description: Maximum line length for readable copy. Separate from the spacing scale.
